games.rules:
4 teams per house, 8 players per team.
5 overs a side.
Inside the house first (I v II, III v IV, I v III, II v IV); then the house playoffs and champion match; semi-finals Jinnah v Tipu and Iqbal v Sir Syed.
Tie on wins: decided on net run rate.

4 teams per house, 8 players per team.
Two halves of 10 minutes.
Inside the house first (I v II, III v IV, I v III, II v IV); then the house playoffs and champion match; semi-finals Jinnah v Tipu and Iqbal v Sir Syed.
Tie on wins: decided on goals.

4 teams per house, 2 players per team.
Best of 3 games, 15 points each.
Inside the house first (I v II, III v IV, I v III, II v IV); then the house playoffs and champion match; semi-finals Jinnah v Tipu and Iqbal v Sir Syed.
Tie on wins: decided on points.
